text: Low-angle view along a white workbench/rail track that runs from the bottom of the frame into the room. On the bench are several white mounting blocks with metal bolts, a grey aluminium rail, and a printed marker card (black pattern on white) at the lower left. Above and left, a white robotic arm with black joint caps extends over the bench; beside it are a black articulated bracket and a blue and white device clamped to the bench edge. Behind, a pink and white sign panel hangs on the wall. Mid-room: a desk with a monitor, a laptop, red and orange items on a shelf, and a black office chair. At right stands a tall white cabinet/fridge with a blue-capped bottle on top. Ceiling strip lights are lit.
